name: record_stream
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI), copied verbatim: aten::record_stream(Tensor(a!) self, Stream s) -> (). This representative signature is selected for the definition but is not exclusive: the original Gems pytest owns the full contract, including overloads, keyword arguments, return values, errors, aliasing and mutation, and must not be narrowed to this one signature. Semantics: caching-allocator bookkeeping. It marks the storage backing self as used by stream s so the allocator cannot hand the block out again before s completes. It returns None, reads no element, does not rebind or reconfigure the stream it was given, and leaves the operand's shape, strides, storage offset, data_ptr, untyped_storage data_ptr and dtype untouched, including when self is a view (the view's storage is recorded, no copy and no rebind). Behavior is overload-independent here (single registered overload). Registered ATen schemas supplied for this operator: aten::record_stream(Tensor(a!) self, Stream s) -> (). Errors remain in pytest: invalid self (int, list, None) and invalid stream (float, None) raise RuntimeError/TypeError.
